_comment: The precursor cargo (docs/start-and-chapter-one.md §2): crates in two cargo landers, unpacked with E onto the build bar's Unpacked tab. Keys starting with _ are not items: _shell_kg is hull kit for printable shells (General Module, corridors, partitions, windows), _feedstock_kg and _earth_parts feed the fabricator, _hand_corer is the ice-coring tool. Sizes: small (kit), long (frames), tall (tanks).

crates.label: Habitat shells
crates.note: One General Module, two corridor sections and the hull kit for them, and an airlock.

crates.label: Life support
crates.note: The General Module's utility rack and a CO₂ scrubber.

crates.label: Outside
crates.note: The suit's rack, GAR-Y's dock and the sampling kit: a hand corer for ice, a scoop and a six-slot sample case.

crates.label: Fabricator stock
crates.note: Polymer and metal powder, and the electronics, seals and sensors Mars can't make.
